rules.title: Strict 0.1% Consumer Cap on Hydrogen Peroxide
rules.expected_requirement: Maximum 0.1% w/w hydrogen peroxide present or released in cosmetic products sold directly to consumers.
rules.explanation: Unlike the US (which allows up to 14% OTC), EU Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 strictly limits consumer oral hygiene and cosmetic products to 0.1% hydrogen peroxide. Concentrations between 0.1% and 6% can only be sold to registered dental practitioners.
rules.fix_suggestion: Reformulate formulation to <= 0.1% hydrogen peroxide, or use approved alternative whitening agents (e.g., PAP - Phthalimidoperoxycaproic acid).

rules.title: Cosmetic Claim Substantiation & Medical Borderline Prohibition
rules.expected_requirement: Claims must adhere to common criteria (legal compliance, truthfulness, evidence, honesty, fairness). No therapeutic or curative claims allowed for cosmetics.
rules.explanation: Claiming that a cosmetic product cures or treats a medical condition triggers reclassification as a Class I/II Medical Device under MDR 2017/745, requiring Notified Body CE audit and clinical evaluation.
rules.fix_suggestion: Rephrase to compliant cosmetic claims: 'formulated to soothe and refresh skin' or 'comforting massage balm'.

rules.title: Mandatory EU Responsible Person (RP) Contact & Address
rules.expected_requirement: Name and address of an EU-established Responsible Person (RP) printed on primary packaging.
rules.explanation: Article 4 mandates that non-EU brands must appoint an EU-based Responsible Person who holds the Product Information File (PIF) and Safety Assessment (CPSR). Without an EU RP address on the pack, customs will detain the shipment.
rules.fix_suggestion: Contract an EU Responsible Person service provider and print their legal EU address on label declarations.

rules.title: Mandatory INCI Ingredient Nomenclature & PAO Symbol
rules.expected_requirement: Ingredient list prefaced by the word 'INGREDIENTS' using standard INCI nomenclature, plus Period After Opening (PAO) open-jar symbol.
rules.explanation: EU requires standardized INCI naming for all chemical/botanical substances, listed in descending order of weight. Informal botanical names without INCI format are non-compliant.
rules.fix_suggestion: Provide ingredient listing in full INCI format (e.g. 'Aqua, Sesamum Indicum Seed Oil, Cinnamomum Camphora Bark Oil') with PAO open-jar icon.

rules.title: EU Safety Standard for Baby Walkers (EN 1273 Compliance Check)
rules.expected_requirement: Technical file and test report proving compliance with European Standard EN 1273:2020 (stair-fall prevention and stability requirements).
rules.explanation: Baby walkers are permitted in the EU provided they have laboratory certification proving conformity to EN 1273:2020. This requires accredited testing lab documentation.
rules.fix_suggestion: Provide accredited test report confirming compliance with EN 1273:2020 safety specifications.

rules.title: CE Mark, RoHS & WEEE Compliance for Electrical Goods
rules.expected_requirement: Affixed CE mark, EU Declaration of Conformity (DoC), RoHS hazardous substance testing, and WEEE crossed-out wheelie bin symbol.
rules.explanation: All powered consumer devices imported into the EU must bear the CE mark, satisfy RoHS limits for lead/mercury, and register for WEEE recycling compliance.
rules.fix_suggestion: Prepare EU Declaration of Conformity and compile CE Technical File before import.
